name: home-assistant-admin
description: Reusable Home Assistant administration workflow with safe editing, validation, rollback, HA-MCP recovery, AppDaemon, custom integrations, and Solis/Eimo troubleshooting.

interface.shortDescription: Safely inspect, modify and troubleshoot Home Assistant.
interface.longDescription: Reusable Home Assistant administration workflow for connected HA apps/MCP: safe inspect, backup, edit, validation, reload/restart, rollback, AppDaemon, custom integrations, HA-MCP reconnection, logs, and Solis/Eimo recovery. Live writes use the user's existing HA connection; secret Connect URLs are never bundled.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Home Assistant and fix the issue safely.
Update my HA configuration with backup and validation.
Diagnose my Solis/Eimo integration and restore communication.
